name: Campingplatz Schliersee
beschreibung: The Schliersee campsite is located in the village of Schliersee in Tirol, Österreich. The surrounding area is characterized by mountains and forests and offers a quiet and close-to-nature atmosphere. In the surrounding area, hiking trails and, in winter, ski areas are accessible. The site offers pitches for motorhomes and tents, which can be supplied with electricity and water. Sanitary facilities are available. This makes the campsite a base for outdoor activities.
